evidence.title: The VIX Explosion of 2024: Insights & Market Impact | tastylive
evidence.summary: This source details a significant VIX explosion in 2024, including a 64.9% increase on August 5, which is the second-largest overnight percentage change in VIX history. It also notes that the VIX closed above 20 for the first time since October 2023 on Friday (implied August 2nd or 3rd), and above 15 on July 18, breaking a two-month period of calm. This establishes a historical precedent for large, rapid VIX movements within 2024, suggesting that a significant change in December is plausible.

evidence.title: Wall Street's Fear Gauge VIX Points to Local Bitcoin Bottom
evidence.summary: This article reports that on December 18, the VIX skyrocketed by 74%, marking the second-largest one-day jump in its history. This directly provides a specific, very large VIX change within December 2024, which is a strong mechanism for the VIX to resolve 'above recent range'.

evidence.title: Lookup Quote
evidence.summary: This source provides daily VIX closing prices for December 2024, including a -1.48% change on 12/30, 0.00% on 12/27, -0.98% on 12/26, +1.49% on 12/25, and -0.98% on 12/24. While individual daily changes are small, the presence of these specific data points for December 2024 confirms the VIX's activity during the target period and allows for calculation of the monthly change.

evidence.title: Sentiment Backdrop Mixed Ahead of Fed Decision
evidence.summary: Published mid-December, this source notes that the VIX was near its 2024 lows, attracting call buyers anticipating or hedging against higher volatility. It also states that heavy call buying relative to put buying on VIX futures has tended to foreshadow higher volatility. This suggests an underlying sentiment and options activity that could drive VIX higher in December.

evidence.title: Short-Term Levels to Watch After Fed-Induced Slide
evidence.summary: This source, published late December, reiterates the observation from a week prior about VIX call buyers anticipating higher volatility and lower stock prices. It also mentions that equity option buyers on S&P 500 Index components were displaying extreme optimism, while VIX futures option buyers (smart money) were hinting at higher volatility ahead. This reinforces the mechanism of options activity foreshadowing VIX movement.

evidence.title: Volatility May Be Returning To A Stock Market Near You
evidence.summary: Published early December, this article notes that the VIX index finished the day flat at around 13.5, while the VVIX (volatility of VIX) rose for the second day in a row, closing just below 87. This indicates that while the VIX itself was calm early in the month, the volatility of volatility was increasing, which could precede a larger VIX move.

evidence.title: Markets & Economy Update - The Year in Review - Destiny Capital
evidence.summary: This year-end review states that volatility was 'abnormally tame throughout 2024 and well below the aforementioned historical average (19.5)'. It notes a short-lived spike in August but emphasizes the overall low volatility. This provides context for the VIX's behavior leading into December, suggesting that a significant increase in December would be a departure from the year's trend.

evidence.title: Market Commentary: ‘Tis the Season — Five Things to Know About Markets in December - Oakeson Steiner Wealth & Retirement
evidence.summary: This source provides general market commentary for December 2024, which can include typical seasonal trends or expectations for market behavior. While not directly about VIX, it sets the broader market context for the month.
